item.title: Accelerating inverse materials design using generative diffusion models with reinforcement learning
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 26 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01334-5

Chen et al. present MatInvent, a reinforcement learning workflow that fine-tunes diffusion models to design crystals meeting single or multiple property targets, with far fewer property calculations than previous methods.
item.dc:title: Accelerating inverse materials design using generative diffusion models with reinforcement learning
item.dc:creator: Junwu Chen
Jeff Guo
Edvin Fako
Philippe Schwaller

item.title: A measurement noise scaling law for cellular representation learning
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 26 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01332-7

Gowri et al. identify a simple mathematical relationship between the performance of a machine learning model and noise in its training data. The relationship might help to guide machine learning efforts in biology and other fields where data are noisy.
item.dc:title: A measurement noise scaling law for cellular representation learning
item.dc:creator: Gokul Gowri
Igor Sadalski
Dan Raviv
Peng Yin
Jonathan Rosenfeld
